info.title: Sessionboard Public API
info.description: REST API for managing sessions, speakers, contacts, sponsors, exhibitors, and event data on the Sessionboard platform.

tags.name: CRM
tags.description: Sessionboard CRM: People (everyone the organization knows, tagged speaker, member, customer, prospect, influencer or attendee) and Companies (sponsors and exhibitors, with the people who work there), the spreadsheet import, reading people from a connected CRM, AMS or event platform, the pipeline, contracts sent for e-signature, warm opportunities and hand-offs to the other Sessionboard apps. Contacts are the platform record behind a speaker or a company's person; the pipeline and contracts use them. Standard fields only: custom fields are a platform upgrade. Free up to 1,000 active contacts; nothing is blocked over the limit. Organization-level: paths start at `/v1/organization/{orgId}/crm`; the same operations are served under `/v1/org/{orgId}/crm` and, with the organization taken from the token, `/v1/crm`. Requires the preview scopes `read:crm` / `write:crm`, which a token or OAuth client gets only when they are named explicitly. The POSTs that only read (`import/parse`, `import/preview`, `apps/{appId}/discover`) need `read:crm`. Request bodies are camelCase; responses are snake_case. A key restricted to particular events cannot use it. Only sending, resending and voiding a contract emails anyone.

tags.name: CRM contacts
tags.description: Search, read, add, change, tag and delete contacts, add notes, and export. Same scopes and paths as CRM.

tags.name: CRM tags
tags.description: The organization's tags (static contact lists). Deleting a tag keeps its contacts. Same scopes and paths as CRM.

tags.name: CRM import
tags.description: The spreadsheet import: the sample file, reading a CSV's columns, a preview that writes nothing, then the import. Same scopes and paths as CRM.

tags.name: CRM connections
tags.description: Connected CRMs, AMSs and event platforms (the same connections Marketing and Sessions use), and discovering who they hold, read-only, before importing. Same scopes and paths as CRM.

tags.name: CRM pipeline
tags.description: The pipeline: stages, one entry per contact, moves with a note and the history of every move. The Sessionboard platform's own pipeline, so an upgrade keeps it. Same scopes and paths as CRM.

tags.name: CRM contracts
tags.description: Contracts sent for signature with Sessionboard e-sign: list, read, send, resend, void, the PDF, templates and the built-in starters. Sending, resending and voiding reach the signer, so confirm them with a person first. Same scopes and paths as CRM.

tags.name: CRM people
tags.description: Everyone the organization knows (Marketing's People) with the CRM view, warm opportunities, adding people to contacts (linked, never merged), and handing a selection to Marketing, Sessions, Learning or Awards. Same scopes and paths as CRM.

tags.name: CRM companies
tags.description: Companies (the Sessionboard platform's Accounts) tagged sponsor or exhibitor, and the people who work at each. Same scopes and paths as CRM.

get.description: The organization, contacts by type, tags and accounts; active contacts used against the plan (a rolling 365 days); the setup steps; the five most recent contacts; and what the Sessionboard platform adds. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm`, and at `GET /v1/crm` with the organization taken from the token.

Search, filter, sort and page the organization's contacts. `facets` counts each type, tag and source for the current search. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contacts`, and at `GET /v1/crm/contacts` with the organization taken from the token.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only contacts with this tag id.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only contacts from this source (a key from `facets.sources`).

parameters.name: stage_id
parameters.description: Only contacts in this pipeline stage (an id from `GET …/crm/pipeline/stages`).

post.description: Adds a contact. An email already in the organization answers `409` with `code: exists` and the existing contact. Emails no one. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contacts`, and at `POST /v1/crm/contacts` with the organization taken from the token.

delete.description: Deletes the contacts named in `ids` from the organization's list. Ask the person first. The token's user needs the Contacts delete permission. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `DELETE /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contacts`, and at `DELETE /v1/crm/contacts` with the organization taken from the token.

post.summary: Change types and tags on many contacts
post.description: Adds or removes types and tags on every contact in `ids`. Types and tags not named stay as they are. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contacts/bulk`, and at `POST /v1/crm/contacts/bulk` with the organization taken from the token.

get.description: The contacts matching the same filters as the list, as columns and rows to write a spreadsheet from, up to 25,000. The token's user needs the Contacts export permission. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contacts/export`, and at `GET /v1/crm/contacts/export` with the organization taken from the token.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only contacts with this tag id.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only contacts from this source (a key from `facets.sources`).

parameters.name: stage_id
parameters.description: Only contacts in this pipeline stage (an id from `GET …/crm/pipeline/stages`).

get.description: One contact with their history across the organization's events, campaigns, contracts and forms, and the team's notes. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contacts/{contactId}`, and at `GET /v1/crm/contacts/{contactId}` with the organization taken from the token.

pipeline.description: The contact's open pipeline entry, if any.

put.description: Changes only the fields sent. `types` and `tagIds` replace the contact's whole list. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `PUT /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contacts/{contactId}`, and at `PUT /v1/crm/contacts/{contactId}` with the organization taken from the token.

post.summary: Add a note to a contact
post.description: Adds a note to the contact, signed by the token's user. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contacts/{contactId}/notes`, and at `POST /v1/crm/contacts/{contactId}/notes` with the organization taken from the token.

get.description: Every tag (the organization's static contact lists) with how many contacts have it. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/tags`, and at `GET /v1/crm/tags` with the organization taken from the token.

post.description: Creates a tag. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/tags`, and at `POST /v1/crm/tags` with the organization taken from the token.

put.description: Renames a tag. Every contact that has it keeps it. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `PUT /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/tags/{tagId}`, and at `PUT /v1/crm/tags/{tagId}` with the organization taken from the token.

delete.description: Deletes a tag. The contacts that had it are kept. Ask the person first. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `DELETE /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/tags/{tagId}`, and at `DELETE /v1/crm/tags/{tagId}` with the organization taken from the token.

get.description: A sample CSV with every column an import takes, as a file download. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/import/sample`, and at `GET /v1/crm/import/sample` with the organization taken from the token.

post.description: Reads a CSV and returns its columns, the first five rows and the suggested column → field mapping, with the fields an import takes. Writes nothing, so `read:crm` is enough. Send CSV text as `{ csv }`; file uploads are for the Sessionboard CRM pages. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/import/parse`, and at `POST /v1/crm/import/parse` with the organization taken from the token.

What an import would do, without doing it: how many rows are new, already contacts or invalid (with the line and reason), emails repeated in the file, and up to 200 rows as they would be saved. Writes nothing, so `read:crm` is enough. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/import/preview`, and at `POST /v1/crm/import/preview` with the organization taken from the token.

csv.description: CSV text with a header row (up to 250 rows on `POST …/crm/import`).

mapping.description: Column → field (`email`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `name`, `company`, `title`, `types`, `tags`), as `import/parse` suggests. Optional with `rows`.

post.description: Imports rows or a CSV, matched by email, up to 250 rows a call (send more in several calls). `updateExisting: true` fills in existing contacts' details from the rows; otherwise they are left as they are. After a discovery, send the chosen rows with `source` set to the app id. Emails no one. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/import`, and at `POST /v1/crm/import` with the organization taken from the token.

csv.description: CSV text with a header row (up to 250 rows on `POST …/crm/import`).

mapping.description: Column → field (`email`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `name`, `company`, `title`, `types`, `tags`), as `import/parse` suggests. Optional with `rows`.

source.description: Where the rows came from: the app id after `apps/{appId}/discover`.

target.description: `people` (rows: email, names, title, `roles`, `company` name, which is found or created and linked) or `companies` (rows: name, website, `tags`).

get.description: The CRMs, association management systems and event platforms contacts can be read from (contacts from HubSpot, Salesforce and iMIS; one event's speakers from Cvent, Swoogo, Bizzabo, ON24 and Goldcast): connected or not, health, the kinds of people each brings, and whether it needs one of its events chosen first. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/apps`, and at `GET /v1/crm/apps` with the organization taken from the token.

post.description: Connects the app with the fields it asks for. This is the same connection Sessionboard Marketing and Sessions use. The token's user must be an organization admin. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/apps/{appId}/connect`, and at `POST /v1/crm/apps/{appId}/connect` with the organization taken from the token.

delete.description: Disconnects the app. Contacts already imported from it are kept. The token's user must be an organization admin. Ask the person first. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `DELETE /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/apps/{appId}`, and at `DELETE /v1/crm/apps/{appId}` with the organization taken from the token.

post.description: Checks that Sessionboard can read from the connected app. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/apps/{appId}/test`, and at `POST /v1/crm/apps/{appId}/test` with the organization taken from the token.

get.description: The connected event platform's events, to choose `remoteEventId` for a discovery. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/apps/{appId}/remote-events`, and at `GET /v1/crm/apps/{appId}/remote-events` with the organization taken from the token.

post.description: Reads who the connected app holds and compares them with the organization's contacts by email: contacts from a CRM or AMS (HubSpot, Salesforce, iMIS), or the speakers of one event from an event platform (Cvent, Swoogo, Bizzabo, ON24, Goldcast; send `remoteEventId`), and members from iMIS. An event's attendees are counted, not returned: bring them in with `POST …/crm/apps/{appId}/attendees`. Each kind says `as` (contacts or people). Writes nothing, in Sessionboard or in the app, so `read:crm` is enough. Review the rows, then send the chosen ones to `POST …/crm/import` with `source` set to the app id. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/apps/{appId}/discover`, and at `POST /v1/crm/apps/{appId}/discover` with the organization taken from the token.

kinds.description: Which of the app's `people_kinds`; all by default.

remoteEventId.description: The app's event, when the app has `needs_event`.

defaultType.description: The type found people get when the app does not say.

get.description: The organization's pipeline stages in order, with how many entries each holds. The eight default stages (identified, researching, approved, contacted, interested, confirmed, declined, future_fit) are added the first time they are read. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/pipeline/stages`, and at `GET /v1/crm/pipeline/stages` with the organization taken from the token.

Search, filter, sort and page the pipeline. One entry per contact; `facets.stages` counts each stage for the current search. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/pipeline`, and at `GET /v1/crm/pipeline` with the organization taken from the token.

parameters.name: stage_id
parameters.description: Only entries in this stage (an id from `GET …/crm/pipeline/stages`).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only contacts with this tag id.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A leading `-` sorts descending. `entered` is when the entry entered its stage; `activity` its last activity. Default `-activity`.

post.description: Adds up to 200 contacts to the pipeline, in `stageId` (the first stage by default) and, if given, for one event. A contact that already has an open entry is skipped and listed in `already`. Emails no one. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/pipeline`, and at `POST /v1/crm/pipeline` with the organization taken from the token.

eventId.description: The event they are being considered for.

already.description: Contact ids that were already in the pipeline.

get.description: The pipeline, filtered like `GET …/crm/pipeline`, as columns and rows for a spreadsheet. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/pipeline/export`, and at `GET /v1/crm/pipeline/export` with the organization taken from the token.

parameters.name: stage_id
parameters.description: Only entries in this stage (an id from `GET …/crm/pipeline/stages`).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only contacts with this tag id.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A leading `-` sorts descending. `entered` is when the entry entered its stage; `activity` its last activity. Default `-activity`.

patch.description: Moves the entry to another stage, with an optional note (a note is kept only with a stage move), or changes the event it is for (`409` when the contact already has an open entry for that event). Every stage move is kept in the entry's history. Emails no one. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `PATCH /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/pipeline/{entryId}`, and at `PATCH /v1/crm/pipeline/{entryId}` with the organization taken from the token.

eventId.description: The event the entry is for; `null` clears it.

delete.description: Takes the entry off the pipeline. The contact, its history and its contracts are kept. Ask the person first. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `DELETE /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/pipeline/{entryId}`, and at `DELETE /v1/crm/pipeline/{entryId}` with the organization taken from the token.

get.description: Every stage move of the entry, oldest first: from and to, who or what made it, the note and when. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/pipeline/{entryId}/history`, and at `GET /v1/crm/pipeline/{entryId}/history` with the organization taken from the token.

Search, filter, sort and page the organization's contracts. `facets.statuses` counts each status for the current search. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contracts`, and at `GET /v1/crm/contracts` with the organization taken from the token.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search the title and the contact.

post.description: Creates a contract for the contact from a published template and sends it for signature with Sessionboard e-sign: the signer is emailed a link to the signing page. This reaches someone outside the organization and cannot be taken back, only voided, so confirm the recipient with the person first. Sending makes the contact an active contact. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contracts`, and at `POST /v1/crm/contracts` with the organization taken from the token.

eventId.description: The event the agreement is for: its branding and variables.

get.description: The contracts, filtered like `GET …/crm/contracts`, as columns and rows for a spreadsheet. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contracts/export`, and at `GET /v1/crm/contracts/export` with the organization taken from the token.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search the title and the contact.

get.description: One contract with each signer's role, name, email, status and signing time, and its history. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contracts/{contractId}`, and at `GET /v1/crm/contracts/{contractId}` with the organization taken from the token.

post.description: Withdraws a contract that is not complete (created, sent or delivered): every signing link stops working and it cannot be signed or brought back. Ask the person first. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contracts/{contractId}/void`, and at `POST /v1/crm/contracts/{contractId}/void` with the organization taken from the token.

Emails the signer the contract is waiting on again, with a fresh link when the old one expired. Confirm with the person first. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contracts/{contractId}/resend`, and at `POST /v1/crm/contracts/{contractId}/resend` with the organization taken from the token.

get.description: A short-lived link (`expires_in_seconds`) to the signed PDF, with its signing certificate. Answers `404` until everyone has signed (`has_pdf` on the contract says when it is ready). Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contracts/{contractId}/pdf`, and at `GET /v1/crm/contracts/{contractId}/pdf` with the organization taken from the token.

The organization's contract templates and the built-in starters (speaker, sponsor and exhibitor agreements). Only a published template can be sent. Editing a template's wording or signer roles is done in Sessionboard's template editor. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contract-templates`, and at `GET /v1/crm/contract-templates` with the organization taken from the token.

post.description: Creates a template from a built-in starter and publishes it, so it can be sent at once. Idempotent: when the starter is already one of the organization's templates, that template is returned (published if it was a draft) with `created: false`. Sends nothing. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/contract-templates/starter`, and at `POST /v1/crm/contract-templates/starter` with the organization taken from the token.

created.description: `false` when the starter was already there.

get.description: Everyone the organization knows, one row per email: contacts, attendees, members, prospects and customers, and the team. The same People list Sessionboard Marketing reads, with the CRM view of each. Attendees and members are people, not contacts, until `POST …/crm/people/add-to-contacts`. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/people`, and at `GET /v1/crm/people` with the organization taken from the token.

parameters.name: roles
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag chips (`speaker,member`): people with any of them. Also `untagged`.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: People who work at this company.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Only people with this role: speaker, sponsor, attendee, member, added…

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only people whose contact has this type.

parameters.name: lifecycle
parameters.description: The CRM's latest lifecycle stage: customer, prospect, lead…

parameters.name: in_pipeline
parameters.description: In the pipeline or not (through their contact).

parameters.name: attended
parameters.description: Came, or registered and did not; with `event_id`, that event.

parameters.name: warm
parameters.description: Warm opportunities: 5 or more distinct webinars or events attended, not in the pipeline, not a customer.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Active contacts in the last 365 days, or not.

post.description: Adds a person (one per email in the organization). Tags have side effects, each idempotent: `speaker` also makes them a contact, `member` records their membership, `customer` and `prospect` record a lifecycle change. `companyId` links them to a company (which also makes them a contact of it). An email already here answers `409` with `code: exists`. Emails no one. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/people`, and at `POST /v1/crm/people` with the organization taken from the token.

delete.description: Deletes people by key. Their contacts, contracts and pipeline entries are not deleted. Ask the person first. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `DELETE /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/people`, and at `DELETE /v1/crm/people` with the organization taken from the token.

get.description: The people, filtered like `GET …/crm/people`, as columns and rows for a spreadsheet. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/people/export`, and at `GET /v1/crm/people/export` with the organization taken from the token.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Only people with this role: speaker, sponsor, attendee, member, added…

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only people whose contact has this type.

parameters.name: lifecycle
parameters.description: The CRM's latest lifecycle stage: customer, prospect, lead…

parameters.name: in_pipeline
parameters.description: In the pipeline or not (through their contact).

parameters.name: attended
parameters.description: Came, or registered and did not; with `event_id`, that event.

parameters.name: warm
parameters.description: Warm opportunities: 5 or more distinct webinars or events attended, not in the pipeline, not a customer.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Active contacts in the last 365 days, or not.

get.description: One person: the CRM view, every signal in time order (registered, attended, watched, opened, membership and lifecycle changes) and the contact they are linked to. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/people/{key}`, and at `GET /v1/crm/people/{key}` with the organization taken from the token.

put.description: Changes the fields sent. `roles` and `companyIds` replace the whole list (tag side effects as on create). Standard fields only: custom fields are a Sessionboard platform upgrade (`GET …/crm/fields`). Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `PUT /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/people/{key}`, and at `PUT /v1/crm/people/{key}` with the organization taken from the token.

post.description: Creates a contact for each person without one (a contact already holding the email is linked instead) and links the person to it. The two stay separate records. Emails no one. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/people/add-to-contacts`, and at `POST /v1/crm/people/add-to-contacts` with the organization taken from the token.

Starts the event platform's own attendee sync (Cvent, Swoogo, Bizzabo) for one of its events: attendees land in People and the attendees layer, never in contacts. Returns the job. Running it again brings the attendees up to date. Reads the platform only. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/apps/{appId}/attendees`, and at `POST /v1/crm/apps/{appId}/attendees` with the organization taken from the token.

eventId.description: The Sessionboard event the attendees belong to.

put.description: Brings in new people from the app every night, the way they were first brought in (`kinds`, landing `as` contacts or people); `schedule: off` stops it and keeps everyone brought in. Answers `403` with `code: sync_disabled` while keeping in sync is not turned on for the organization. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `PUT /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/apps/{appId}/sync`, and at `PUT /v1/crm/apps/{appId}/sync` with the organization taken from the token.

get.description: Where a selection can be handed: Sessionboard Marketing, Sessions, Learning and Awards, each with `owned` and the link that opens it (`href`) or, when the organization does not have it, its trial page (`upsell_href`). Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/handoffs`, and at `GET /v1/crm/handoffs` with the organization taken from the token.

post.description: Saves a selection (person keys, contact ids, or everyone matching people filters) as a new tag named for where it came from and the date, and returns it with the link that opens the app with it (`?crm_tag=`), or the app's trial page. Emails no one. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/handoffs/tag`, and at `POST /v1/crm/handoffs/tag` with the organization taken from the token.

name.description: The tag's name; made from the selection and date otherwise.

post.description: Adds and removes tags on up to 500 people at once; their other tags stay. Adding `speaker` makes contacts of those without one (`contacts_created`). Removing a tag undoes only what can be undone (membership); contacts, pipeline entries and contracts stay. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/people/roles`, and at `POST /v1/crm/people/roles` with the organization taken from the token.

get.description: The organization's companies (the Accounts module): search, filter by tag chips (`tags`, any of), sort and page. `facets.tags` counts sponsor, exhibitor and untagged. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/companies`, and at `GET /v1/crm/companies` with the organization taken from the token.

post.description: Adds a company. A `sponsor` or `exhibitor` tag also shows it on the Sessionboard platform's sponsor or exhibitor pages. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/companies`, and at `POST /v1/crm/companies` with the organization taken from the token.

delete.description: Deletes companies by id (to the Sessionboard platform's Trash). Their people stay. Ask the person first. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `DELETE /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/companies`, and at `DELETE /v1/crm/companies` with the organization taken from the token.

get.description: The companies, filtered like `GET …/crm/companies`, as columns and rows for a spreadsheet. Reads only. Requires `read:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `GET /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/companies/export`, and at `GET /v1/crm/companies/export` with the organization taken from the token.

put.description: Changes the fields sent; `tags` replaces the list. Standard fields only. Requires `write:crm`. Refused for a key restricted to particular events. Also at `POST /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/companies/{companyId}/people`, and at `POST /v1/crm/companies/{companyId}/people` with the organization taken from the token.

delete.summary: Unlink a person from a company

Also at `DELETE /v1/org/{orgId}/crm/companies/{companyId}/people/{key}`, and at `DELETE /v1/crm/companies/{companyId}/people/{key}` with the organization taken from the token.

ApiKey.name: x-access-token
ApiKey.description: Organization API token. Generate from Organization Settings → API Tokens.

BearerToken.description: OAuth 2.1 access token. Obtained via the OAuth PKCE flow at `/oauth/token`.

CrmOrgId.name: orgId
CrmOrgId.description: Your organization ID. Any other organization returns `404`.

CrmContactType.description: Speaker, Subject-matter expert (SME), Influencer, Exhibitor contact, Sponsor contact. Stored on the contact as the organization's "Contact type" field.

active.description: An active contact in the last 365 days.

stage.description: The contact's pipeline stage; `null` when not in the pipeline.

CrmImportRowInput.description: A row in the import's field keys (the same keys a preview or discovery returns, so its rows can be sent back unchanged).

name.description: A full name, instead of first and last.

contact_id.description: With `existing`: the contact the row matches.

people_kinds.description: The kinds of people the app can bring in.

truncated.description: The app held more than one discovery returns.

not_available.description: Kind → why the app does not share it.

as.description: Kind → where its rows land. Attendees of an event platform are only counted here; bring them in with `POST …/crm/apps/{appId}/attendees`.

contact.description: With `code: exists`: the contact that has the email.

system_key.description: The default stage this is (identified, researching, approved, contacted, interested, confirmed, declined, future_fit).

actor_type.description: Who or what moved it: a person, an automation, a signed contract.

actor.description: The person's name, when a person moved it.

CrmContractStatus.description: `delivered`: the signer opened the signing page. `completed`: everyone signed.

source.description: How it was sent: `native` is Sessionboard e-sign.

CrmLandsAs.description: Where brought-in rows land: contacts, or people (members, prospects, customers).

CrmPersonRole.description: A person tag. A person can have any number.

CrmCompanyTag.description: A company tag. A company can have both.

id.description: The People record id; `null` for someone known only from a source.

roles.description: The tags set on the person.

derived_roles.description: Roles read from their activity (for example attendee from an attended event), not set as tags.

contact_id.description: The linked contact, the record the pipeline and contracts use.

upsell_href.description: The app's trial page (when not owned).

CrmReadForbidden.description:
- `SCOPE_REQUIRED`: the token lacks `read:crm`.
- `ORG_WIDE_TOKEN_REQUIRED`: the key is restricted to particular events; use a key without an event restriction.
- `FORBIDDEN`: the token's user cannot read the organization's contacts.

CrmWriteForbidden.description:
- `SCOPE_REQUIRED`: the token lacks `write:crm` (or `read:crm` for the POSTs that only read).
- `ORG_WIDE_TOKEN_REQUIRED`: the key is restricted to particular events.
- `code: plan_read_only` (or `read_only`): the CRM trial or plan has ended; everything can still be read.
- `code: platform_customer`: the organization works with Sessionboard on a platform contract, so its contacts are in the Sessionboard platform.
- `code: FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED`: contracts are not turned on for the organization (contracts operations only).
- `FORBIDDEN` with no `code`: the token's user lacks the Contacts permission the change needs (connecting and disconnecting apps need an organization admin).

CrmNotFound.description: `NOT_FOUND`: `orgId` is not the token's organization, or the contact, tag or app is not in it.

CrmBadRequest.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR`: the body or a path id does not match the schema.

CrmContactExists.description: `code: exists`: the email is already a contact in the organization; `contact` is that contact. Nothing was added.

CrmTooManyRequests.description: The token's request limit (100 requests per 15 minutes by default) or, for writes, its daily write quota. Wait `Retry-After` seconds.

CrmContractConflict.description: `CONFLICT`: the contract is not in a state that allows this (already completed, declined or voided), or the contact already has an open pipeline entry for that event. Nothing was changed.
